snippet.title: Kirby Air Riders – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
Kirby Air Riders is releasing for Nintendo Switch 2 on Nov 20, 2025. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/kirby-air-riders-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Two new Kirby Air Riders amiibo, Kirby & Warp Star and Bandana Waddle Dee & Winged Star, will be available alongside the game’s launch on Nov 20, with more Kirby Air Riders amiibo on the way!

Additionally, a second Kirby Air Riders Direct, hosted by the game’s director, Mr. Sakurai, is also on the way! Stay tuned for more info.

#KirbyAirRiders #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
